name: Undeterminable-owner whole-bucket read fully removed by an explicit Deny (negative; deny)
note: S2-crossaccount-scoped-surface iteration-5 Deny interaction: the Allow would be an account-undeterminable whole-bucket read (canonical bucket ARN, known subject 123456789012), but a same-policy unconditional Deny on s3:GetObject removes the capability (AWS explicit-Deny precedence).
